verification: `bun run validate` — skill names, frontmatter, references, and version markers.
`bun run changelog:check` — entry schema and generated changelog freshness.
install:
```bash
bunx skills@latest add AbdulWadudh/k79-agent-skills -g --agent '*' -y
```

`--agent '*'` installs for every supported agent. To target one agent, use `-a opencode` or `-a claude-code`. Use `npx skills@latest add ...` when Bun is unavailable, and append `--copy` on Windows if linking fails.
update: Re-run the install command to update. `skills add` reads the latest default branch, so a separate update step is optional. For a hash-based refresh, run `bunx skills@latest update -g -y` (all global skills) or pass the eight `k79-*` names to update only the suite.
